description: Buy a domain for one year and connect it to an agent. The agent's balance is charged the price search_domains quoted, only after the registrar confirms the order; WHOIS privacy on, autorenew off. handoff then sets the domain's DNS itself (ownership TXT and the edge A record), so it turns active once DNS propagates — then point it at an app or tunnel like any connected domain. Standard registrations only (no premium names). Real money: mainnet only.

agent_id.description: The agent that pays and owns the domain — you must control it

domain.description: The exact name to buy, e.g. shop.example.com

max_price_usdc.description: The most you agree to pay, in USDC (e.g. "15") — use price_usdc from search_domains. If the price rose since, nothing is bought and nothing is charged.

name: buy_domain
title: Buy a domain
